Week 5 finals are in the ledger.

- Home teams went 8-6-1 against the closing expectation set by our model.
- Three games finished inside three points.
entries.heading: The numbers

entries.body:
The tie is the story of the week: two teams whose identities are still unsettled met, and neither could impose one.

We grade this read next Tuesday against what Week 6 shows.
entries.heading: Our read

entries.body: Season calibration after Week 5 lives in the tracker; probabilities for Week 6 publish with the Wednesday preview.
